rationale: P identifies the braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. SG-3 explicitly establishes braking as the subject of evaluation, and H-3 grounds it in the stated operational situation and sudden stopping without an obstacle. P does not expand the phenomenon to include supporting sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” is itself required by the Evaluation Target, rather than merely a mechanism affecting its evaluation.
“Whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended” directly addresses the property targeted by SG-3 and hazard H-3.
The declared scope matches H-3: straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather.
P introduces no additional mechanism-level behaviour or timing requirements.
